description: This plot illustrates the relationship between a ratio and the performance metric minFDE_20 for five different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and uses a linear scale representing values from 0.1 to 1.0, with numbered tick intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" and uses a linear scale ranging from below 0.8 to above 1.3, with regular tick intervals of 0.1. The line representing "TrajICL" is blue, solid, and uses circular markers; it begins at approximately 0.90 at an x-value of 0.1, remains relatively steady across the x-axis while passing through 0.86 at x=0.5, and ends at 0.85 at x=1.0. The "Head Tuning" line is orange, solid, and features circular markers, starting at a peak of approximately 1.32 at x=0.1, declining to about 1.08 at x=0.7, reaching a low of 1.06 at x=0.9, and ending slightly higher at 1.07 at x=1.0. The "FT" line is green, solid, and marked with circles; it begins at roughly 1.09 at x=0.1 and exhibits a continuous decline, passing through 0.91 at x=0.5 and concluding at 0.76 at x=1.0. The "LoRA 16" line is red, solid, and has circular markers, starting at 1.22 at x=0.1, decreasing to 1.00 at x=0.5, remaining steady at 0.94 between x=0.7 and x=0.9, and ending at 0.93 at x=1.0. Finally, the "LoRA 64" line is purple, solid, and uses circular markers; it begins at 1.22 at x=0.1, steadily declines to 1.02 at x=0.5 and 0.95 at x=0.9, and ends at 0.93 at x=1.0.
